added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own baseline_suite and after_suite gate logs. This node's declared write paths reach no test path, so its manifest carries no baseline_suite or after_suite arm and the reviewed run produced no suite log; there is no head arm to diff and no added failure ids. The node's measure is a graph census, recorded under the run directory: census-c2-passB.json, census-c3-passB.json, census-c4-final.json (discovered=0, described=367/385/646, hash_mismatch=0) and scope-embed-census.json (facility mismatch 13, all outside scope).

findings.text: the figcaption says the bars are "Drawn from the censuses recorded in reprocess-progress-bulk-6.json", but the generating script make_figure.py carries the per-category counts as a hardcoded DATA literal and reads no census file, so the figure would not change if a census disagreed; the done_when required the figures be read from the census results at run time. The displayed values reconcile exactly with cat_census.json and the progress JSON (0 discovered, 0 in-scope hash mismatch), so this does not hold the node.
